patchNoteLines.li: Reorganize the mod settings to put events settings and military settings in their own tabs
Empire Events can be individually disabled in the settings

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Battle auto-resolve update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes the calculations for auto-resolve battles.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a dampening factor to how much Military Efficiency affects the outcome of auto-resolve battles (its effect was a little too strong). The dampening factor can be changed in the settings.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: More military fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Some more fixes for the military side of Empire.

patchNoteLines.li: The "atk x / def x * <budget>" label in the main military tab is now wider, so the text shouldn't wrap
Bugfix: deploying a squad to a map and then leaving the map before the squad does can result in the squad's settlement being stuck in the "Deployed" state

Changed auto-resolve defense battles: if a defending settlement is being reinforced by another (e.g. through auto-defend), then the combined defensive force uses a mix of the military efficiency of the defending settlement and the reinforcing settlement

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Auto-Defense bugfixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Fixes a couple of issues with the auto-defend feature.

patchNoteLines.li: Loosens restrictions on what settlements can auto-defend
Bugfix: the settlementMilitaryLevel field would sometimes not update when it should, resulting in a settlement that *should* be auto-defending, not actually being chosen to auto-defend

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Event Def Upate
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Updates the FCEventDef with some extra filtering options.

patchNoteLines.li: Adds a 'allowedSettlementTypes' and 'blockedSettlementTypes' fields to FCEventDef
